description: This file defines the core logic for nodes in a question generation and validation workflow for a medical exam preparation bot. It includes methods for retrieving relevant context, generating questions with GPT-4, validating questions, and managing caching and referencing mechanisms.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorNodes
classes.description: Contains methods for context retrieval, question generation, validation, and citation handling for AI-driven medical exam questions.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes AI client, embedding manager, image processor, local vector store, and JSON storage, along with caches.

methods.name: list _get_cached_questions(self, chapter_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves questions for a chapter with caching to minimize disk I/O.

methods.name: float _calculate_question_similarity(self, q1: str, q2: str)
methods.description: Calculates textual similarity between two questions using SequenceMatcher.

methods.name: list[str] _extract_medical_terms(self, text: str)
methods.description: Extracts key medical terms from text based on capitalization and length.

methods.name: tuple[bool,str] _is_question_unique( self, new_question: str, chapter_id: int, threshold: float = 0.55 )
methods.description: Checks if a question is unique based on text similarity and medical term overlap.

methods.name: list[str] _extract_covered_topics(self, questions: list)
methods.description: Extracts the most common medical topics from recent questions.

methods.name: _update_chunk_quality_scores(self, chunks: list, score: int)
methods.description: Updates the quality scores for source chunks based on question similarity metrics.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] retrieve_context(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Retrieves relevant context from a vector store with topic-aware smart selection.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] generate_question(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Generates a question using GPT-4, incorporating context, images, and ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] validate_accuracy(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Validates the medical accuracy, quality, and uniqueness of the generated question.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_citations(self, state: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Finalizes the question with citations, confidence scores, and updates chunk quality data.
